title: Homework after Lesson 6
note: Try every task without «Show answers» first. Lesson 5 still has three empty exercises — let's finish them this week.

items.text: Exercise 12: write 80–100 words «Two places I know» — on the lesson page.
Grammar section: take the quizzes «Comparatives» and «Superlatives».
Lesson 5: do Exercises 6, 8 and 9 and find at least three endings of the story.
Learn the 10 words for describing places (Exercise 2) and do «Test me → Lessons 4–5» in the Irregular verbs tab until 11 / 12.

title: Homework after Lesson 5
note: The «Irregular verbs» tab on the lesson page has a «Test me» button — use it every day for two minutes.

items.text: Exercise 10: write 80–100 words «A day when something went wrong» — on the lesson page.
Irregular verbs tab: learn the 12 new verbs (L5) and do «Test me → Lessons 4–5» until you get at least 10 / 12.
Grammar section: take the quiz «Past Continuous» and do «Present tenses for the future» again (last time 2 / 3).
Find all five endings of the story and finish Exercises 8 and 9.

title: Homework after Lesson 4
note: Try every task without «Show answers» first. If you open the answers, press «Hide answers» and try again.

items.text: Exercise 13: write 70–90 words about your last weekend — on the lesson page.
Learn the 12 irregular verbs from Exercise 4 and the 10 weekend phrases from Exercise 1.
Grammar section: take the quizzes «Past Simple: was / were» and «Past Simple: regular and irregular verbs».
Finish Exercises 11 and 12 on the lesson page if you did not do them in class.
Lesson 3: write the text in Exercise 13 («My usual week — and this week») — it is still empty.

title: Homework after Lesson 3
note: First try every task without «Show answers» — your mistakes show me what to explain next time.

items.text: Exercise 13: write 70–90 words «My usual week — and this week» on the lesson page.
Grammar section: take the quizzes «Present Simple or Present Continuous?» and «Present tenses for the future».
Vocabulary: do the quiz until you get at least 8 / 10, and learn the 10 new words from Lesson 3.
Finish Exercises 11 and 12 on the lesson page if you did not do them in class.

title: Homework after Lesson 2
note: Do everything on the site, not in your notebook — then I can see your answers and help with the mistakes.

items.text: Exercise 13: write 60–80 words about someone you know — on the lesson page.
Learn the 20 words from Lesson 2 — use the flashcards in the Vocabulary section.
Grammar section: take the quizzes on Present Continuous, -ing spelling and Present Simple or Present Continuous?
Finish Exercises 11 and 12 on the lesson page if you did not do them in class.
Lesson 1: open it and check Exercises 13, 14 and 15. If they are empty, do them on the page.

title: Homework after Lesson 1
note: Do a little every day instead of everything on the last evening. The grammar quizzes take 5 minutes each.

items.text: Exercise 15: write 50–70 words about your typical weekday.
Learn the 20 words from Lesson 1 — use the flashcards in the Vocabulary section.
Grammar section: take the quizzes on to be, Present Simple and he / she / it spelling.
Finish Exercises 13 and 14 on the lesson page if you did not do them in class.
Optional: open zno.osvita.ua (Links section) and just look at one NMT English test. Do not try to do it yet.
